verdict.rationale: RustDesk's docs say the client works on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and Web, and it is distributed via F-Droid and Flathub. Hands-on reports confirm cross-OS sessions: Windows to a Mac Mini, Linux to Windows, and Ubuntu with Mac. Some users hit cross-OS glitches, an Android tablet crash, and an older macOS that wouldn't install. missing for 10: first-party documentation of host/viewer cross-OS interoperability and supported OS versions, reliable mobile-to-desktop behavior (one Android reboot report), and Linux-to-Windows parity for alt-tab and file copy-paste.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems
